seoTitle: Fuel Economy Converter: L/100km, MPG US, MPG UK, km/L
metaDescription: Convert L/100km, miles per US gallon, miles per UK gallon and km/L to compare cars across markets. Free.
intro: Converts fuel consumption between litres per 100 km, km per litre, US MPG and UK MPG.
why:
Europe uses L/100km, the US uses MPG and the UK uses MPG with a larger gallon. 30 US MPG is about 36 UK MPG and 7.8 L/100km.

Enter one figure and see all four. Lower L/100km is better, higher MPG is better.

faq.q: Why is UK MPG higher than US MPG?
faq.a: The UK gallon (4.546 L) is larger than the US gallon (3.785 L).

faq.q: How to convert MPG to L/100km?
faq.a: Divide 235.215 by US MPG, or 282.481 by UK MPG.
No, only fuel volume per distance.
